name: Quick Bridge
author: Colin Faulkingham
description: QR-code bridge to upload from a phone, share a file or clipboard, or proxy a local HTTP port over a Cloudflare quick tunnel.

barWidget.description: QR code bridge for phone uploads, file sharing, and local HTTP proxy

schema.label: Save folder
schema.description: Where phone uploads land. Empty uses ~/Downloads/Quick Bridge.

schema.label: Stop after transfer
schema.description: Default for the panel toggle. When on, the tunnel stops after the first upload or download.

schema.label: Require password
schema.description: Default for upload/download. Proxy always requires a 6-digit code shown on the desktop. The code is not in the QR or the link.
